questions.question: When was the amoxicillin allergy or rash first recorded, and what was the reaction and timing relative to the course?
Does any earlier entry document a drug allergy or reaction, given an earlier note said no known drug allergies?
What was the amoxicillin prescribed for, and what course dates and dose were recorded?
Was any alternative antibiotic or allergy management plan documented after the rash?
What were the weight, blood pressure and other vitals from the earlier visit, and were they repeated?
Were any follow-up appointments, referrals or tests planned earlier, and were they completed?
